title: Vontier Schedules Second Quarter 2026 Earnings Call
summary: Vontier Corporation (NYSE: VNT), a leading global provider of critical technologies and solutions to connect, manage and scale the mobility ecosystem, will host a conference call webcast at 8:30 a.m. ET on Thursday, August 6, 2026, to discuss its second quarter 2026 financial results. The live webcast can be accessed at https://vontier-earnings-call-aug-6.open-exchange.net/ , or on the Events Presentations section of Vontier’s Investor Relations website. An accompanying press release and slide presentation will be made available that morning in the same location. A replay of the webcast will be available at the same location shortly after the conclusion of the presentation. ABOUT VONTIER Vontier (NYSE: VNT) is a global technology company uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies to meet the needs of a rapidly evolving, more connected mobility ecosystem.
